description: Cross-mapping: CNVC needs categories to Max-Neef fundamental needs. NOT 1:1 - some overlap, some orthogonal. Mapping is interpretive, not canonical.
caveat: Max-Neef and Rosenberg come from different traditions. Max-Neef: economics/development. Rosenberg: communication/psychology. These frameworks complement each other but don't line up exactly. Use this mapping as a bridge, not as equivalence.

mappings.note: Rosenberg's 'connection' spreads across several Max-Neef needs — affection (intimacy, love), participation (belonging, cooperation), identity (to know and be known).
Authenticity and integrity overlap with Max-Neef's identity (self-consistency) and freedom (assertiveness).
Joy and humor map cleanly to Max-Neef's leisure.
'Peace' in NVC blends inner tranquility (leisure) with harmony (understanding of self and others).

unmapped_maxneef.none: All 9 Max-Neef needs are touched by at least one CNVC category.

additional_notes.max_neef_uniqueness: Max-Neef adds dimensions CNVC doesn't: 'subsistence' as explicit bodily need, 'protection' as systemic/social safety, 'understanding' as epistemic growth separate from connection.
additional_notes.cnvc_uniqueness: CNVC is more granular in interpersonal connection terms (to-know-and-be-known, empathy, mutuality) than Max-Neef's 'affection'.
